network.daily-active-signers.definition: Distinct signers of successful transactions per day (including fee-sponsored users), averaged over the last 30 complete days. Median across /data providers.

network.successful-transactions-30d.definition: Successful non-vote transactions over the last 30 complete days. Median across /data providers.

network.successful-transactions-90d.definition: Successful non-vote transactions over the last 90 complete days. Median across /data providers.

network.average-fee-30d.definition: Total transaction fees (base and priority, valued at each day's SOL price) divided by all non-vote transactions, successful and failed, over the last 30 complete days. Excludes Jito tips.

network.validator-count.definition: Validators voting on mainnet. /validators reads current vote accounts live from mainnet RPC and falls back to the /data daily median.

network.nakamoto-coefficient.definition: Fewest validators (vote accounts) whose combined active stake exceeds one third of total stake, the superminority that could halt consensus. /validators computes it live from getVoteAccounts.

network.slot-time.definition: Target slot time: the interval at which a leader produces a block. Reduced from 400 ms to 200 ms by SIMD-0525, completed at epoch 1053. Not a finality measure.

network.finality-target.definition: Alpenglow's design target for finality, the point at which a block cannot be reverted. Alpenglow replaced TowerBFT on mainnet at epoch 1064. A target, not a measured median.

network.average-tps-30d.definition: Non-vote transactions per second (successful plus failed; vote transactions excluded), averaged over the last 30 complete days. Median across /data providers.

network.active-accounts.definition: Active accounts on Solana as published on /solutions; the measurement window was never stated.
network.active-accounts.note: No source or window found for 11.5M. The data-api 'Active Addresses' metric covers stablecoin addresses only; suggested replacement: network.daily-active-signers.

network.monthly-active-developers.definition: Monthly active developers in the Solana ecosystem.
network.monthly-active-developers.note: Reconciled: /solutions showed 1900+ and /solutions/actions 3000+; 3000+ kept as the shared value. Electric Capital's dashboard (developerreport.com) is JS-rendered and could not be read; secondary figures conflict (2024 report about 2,000-2,500; Solana Foundation 3,200+).

network.active-repositories.definition: Active open-source code repositories in the Solana ecosystem.
network.active-repositories.note: Likely an older Electric Capital figure; the dashboard is not machine-readable and no dated public value was found.

network.net-carbon-impact.definition: Net carbon impact of the Solana network after offsets.
network.net-carbon-impact.note: A policy claim from Solana Foundation climate reporting, not a measured series. A measured alternative is the climate provider's emissions365 (gross emissions), a different measure.

network.successful-transactions-daily-30.definition: Successful non-vote transactions per day, averaged over the last 30 complete days. Median across /data providers.

network.years-without-outage.definition: Years since the last mainnet outage (February 6, 2024), shown as a floor.

source.name: Solana: Building, Proving and Earning Trust in Public

network.years-without-outage.note: The source reports 100% uptime since February 2024 ('two and a half years at 100%'). About 2.7 years had passed by 2026-11-02, so 2.5+ still holds; raise it at the next review.

network.uptime-since-feb-2024.definition: Mainnet uptime since the February 2024 outage, as reported by the Solana Foundation.

source.name: Solana: Building, Proving and Earning Trust in Public

network.block-compute-limit.definition: Maximum compute units per block, raised from 60M to 100M by SIMD-0286 (mainnet epoch 1009). A protocol limit, not an observed figure.

network.max-transaction-size.definition: Maximum serialized size of a v1 transaction, raised from 1,232 bytes by SIMD-0296 at mainnet epoch 1035. A protocol limit.

network.energy-per-transaction.definition: Average electricity per transaction (CCRI methodology), Solana Climate Dashboard.

network.electricity-365d.definition: Network electricity consumption over the trailing 365 days (CCRI methodology), Solana Climate Dashboard.
